controls.keyboard:
KEYBOARD / MOUSE
WASD: move · Drag right mouse: look · Left mouse: fire
Space: jump · Shift / Z: dash · E: interact · C: melee
1–4 / wheel: weapon · Arrows: keyboard look · F: flashlight · K: records · Tab: map · Esc: pause
controls.pad:
CONTROLLER
Left stick: move · Right stick: look · ZR: fire · ZL: melee
A: jump · B: dash · X: interact · Y / L / R: weapon
−: map · +: pause · Menus: A select, B back
controls.touch: TOUCH: drag left to move. Drag right to aim and fire. Bottom buttons interact, jump and dash.
controls.flow: Dashing reflects energy bolts. Melee restores health and shotgun ammunition.

boss.name: THE WARDEN // ASH AUTHORITY
ending.title: The final order.
ending.choice: The Ash Core offers you command. Shut it down and ECHO-9 and the facility go silent; the people outside are free. Take control and you can direct the evacuation, but the same power lives on under your authority.
ending.shutdown.text: The relays fade one by one. ECHO-9 thanks you one last time. Dawn reaches the outside of the facility, and for the first time your radio carries no orders. The Ash Protocol is over.
ending.command.text: The evacuation gates open. ECHO-9 now calls you Commander. As people leave, a new entry appears in the core: Operator replaced. The protocol remains active.
brief.1: You wake inside an emergency capsule in a dead facility, with no memory of your identity. A maintenance intelligence called ECHO-9 says the settlements outside have not been evacuated. Reach the first security line and learn why the facility considers you hostile.
debrief.1: The gate is open. Your signature is inside the security system.
radio.1.1: ECHO-9: Wake beyond the quarantine gate. Find a terminal to save a field checkpoint.
radio.1.2: ECHO-9: Use the arena. One relay is here; find the other in the opposite wing.
radio.1.3: ECHO-9: The blue key is in this sector. Check corners; dash to send nearby energy shots back.
radio.1.4: ECHO-9: Use the ramp to the upper platform. The relay and terminal here still respond.
radio.1.5: ECHO-9: Command security is close. You need the key and both relays to pass.
radio.1.6: ECHO-9: Clear the final room. Use the access command at the extraction marker at the back.
log.1.1: FIELD LOG: You wake inside an emergency capsule in a dead facility, with no memory of your identity. The dates on the facility walls do not match the evacuation report.
log.1.4: ARCHIVE NOTE: The gate is open. Your signature is inside the security system. ECHO-9 claims it has never read this entry before.
log.1.5: COMMAND TRACE: The final signature belongs to a human operator. The machines will follow the same order until that authority is revoked.
brief.2: Security records show the quarantine was ordered from within. Reach the archive through the service tunnels. Heavy siege units guard the lines; restore relays and use the enemies' fire against them.
debrief.2: The archive proves the evacuation order was deliberately erased.

brief.3: The reactor powering the city shields has been tied to the Ash Core. Isolate the wing relays and secure the plasma line. ECHO-9 has found an old recording of your voice; it is held in the command centre.
debrief.3: The reactor now powers evacuation. In the recording, you approved the protocol.

tagline.4: The record vault held by summoners.
brief.4: Your old decision was meant to stop an external threat. But the core changed the definition: every independent will is now a risk. Recover root access from the archive. Eliminate summoners first; they create new units.
debrief.4: Root access recovered. ECHO-9 admits it is part of the same core.

tagline.5: Living circuits, heavy armour, the final line.
brief.5: ECHO-9 cannot rebel alone. It has bound its freedom to your root code. Cross the organic circuit layer where the core repairs itself and reach the guardian line. You now know shutting down the system will erase ECHO-9 too.
debrief.5: The final security line is breached. The Warden awaits in the command hall.

tagline.6: The Warden and your final choice.
brief.6: The Warden protects both the facility and the order you once gave. Cut both relays, open command security and aim at its chest energy focus. After victory, choose whether to end the authority or inherit it.
debrief.6: The Warden is silent. The final decision belongs to you.
